messages:
alex.k: Heads up — planning to ship the release tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need a quick sync on internal announcement copy, version pinning, and rollback play.
jamie.r: timeline works for me. What's the change window? we usually do 2 hours but can shorten if safe.
sara_pm: @product-marketing can we get a 2-sentence blurb for the internal announce? audience = SEs, SRE, support.
mike_ops: Change window 09:00–11:00 UTC. Canary for 10% for 20m, then 50% for 20m, then full if green. Rollback plan is immediate fallback to v3.2.1 pinned image + health-check gating.
lina_engineering: Confirming code and infra are ready. I'll pin inference model to model-gnn:v1.4 for this rollout. If metrics regress we fallback to model-gnn:v1.3.
jamie.r: Can we add an automatic fallback route in the routing policy? example config:
```
routing:
  preferred: model-gnn:v1.4
  fallback: model-gnn:v1.3
  health_check: /health?ok=true
```
alex.k: Yes deploy-bot will trigger the fallback if error-rate>1% or p95 latency > 1200ms during canary.
product-marketing: Draft: "Deploying runtime improvements to reduce tail latency and lower per-token cost. Expect brief canary rollout starting 09:00 UTC; support/outage risk is low. Contact eng-oncall if you see errors."
sara_pm: Nice — can we add the rollback note: "If we observe quality regressions or infra errors, we'll roll back to the previous model and notify the channel." Also include links to release notes + evals.
alex.k: Good call. final internal blurb:
"Tomorrow 09:00 UTC — rolling out runtime + model pin (model-gnn:v1.4). Canary 10%→50%→100%. Expected improvements: lower p95 latency, cost optimizations. If we detect >1% error rate, p95>1200ms, or quality regressions on our eval set, we will rollback to model-gnn:v1.3. See: https://go.redwood/release/183345 for full notes and eval results. Contact @mike_ops or @lina_engineering during the window."
jamie.r: I suggest we add a short checklist for oncall:
- monitor p50/p95/p99 latency
- error rate
- infra GPU utilization
- eval-quality delta on main prompt suite
mike_ops: I'll import that into our runbook and add the dashboard link.
deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-03-21T09:00:00Z — 10% traffic → model-gnn:v1.4. Health checks passing.
lina_engineering: Observability looks clean so far, latency -6% p95, no errors.
alex.k: Keep monitoring. If anything spikes, call rollback. I'll post final internal announcement ~30m after full rollout.
product-marketing: I'll queue the internal slack post + doc update once you give the greenlight.
mike_ops: noted, I'll be on pager for the window.
alex.k: thanks all — tagging this thread as the source for the internal announce. Will update with final status.
